lines.en: and he gave him his disposition, and he was received by him through the place

lines.text: quia erat dominus loci illius. Significauit igitur Saturnus ſa=
lines.en: because he was the lord of that place. Therefore Saturn signified

lines.text: nitatem eius iuſsu Dei, eò quòd recipit Saturnus Mercu=
lines.en: his health by the command of God, because Saturn receives Mercury

lines.text: riũ in domo ſua. Poſt hoc aſpexi cui iungeretur Sol primum
lines.en: in his house. After this I looked to whom the Sun would first join

lines.text: quando egrederetur ad ſecundum ſignum, iungebaturq́;
lines.en: when he would go out to the second sign, and he was joined

lines.text: Sol Ioui, qui eſt dominus domus mortis. Sed recipiebat
lines.en: the Sun to Jupiter, who is the lord of the house of death. But he received

lines.text: eum à domo ſua. Significauit igitur Sol quoq; ſanitatem atq;
lines.en: him from his house. Therefore the Sun also signified health and

lines.text: proſperitatem illius iuſſu Dei, propter receptionem Iouis,
lines.en: his prosperity by the command of God, on account of the reception of Jupiter,

lines.text: qui eum recipiebat, & ſi nõ recepiſſet eum Iupiter, eſſet hoc
lines.en: who received him, and if Jupiter had not received him, this would be

summary.headline: Planetary Reception and Death
summary.text: Astrological judgment of health, prosperity, and possible death through planetary reception: Saturn receives Mercury in his house, while the Sun joins Jupiter, lord of the house of death, whose reception averts a testimony of death.
